descricao_produto: The product is a large 2.4-liter insulated thermos bottle: a tall upright cylinder, about two and a half times taller than its body is wide, with a matte army-green body and black parts. From top to bottom: (1) a black cup-lid shaped like a mug, with a polished stainless-steel top disk and a black square-loop handle on its right side; (2) a thin shiny silver metal ring under the cup-lid; (3) a black rounded shoulder with a small molded tab on the front and a short black notch on the left edge; (4) one large black carry handle on the right side, a tall rectangular loop running from the shoulder down to the middle band; (5) the matte army-green upper body with a black rectangular label on the front, the label shows the word "MODUS" in large bold white letters and, under it, one small line of white text "INTERIOR EM AÇO INOXIDÁVEL SUS 304"; (6) a black horizontal band around the middle of the body, slightly wider than the body; (7) the matte army-green lower body with the small white word "MODUS" near the bottom; (8) a black base. Both handles are on the same right side. No other text, no stickers, no other colors on the bottle.
